heading: Questions You Might Have
subheading: Good questions deserve honest answers. Here are the ones I hear most.
footerText: Got something else on your mind?

items.question: Who are you?
items.answer: I'm Denada, a full-stack developer and AI engineer based in Tirana. Computer engineering degree from Epoka University, data science masters from University of Greenwich, both with distinction. I've spent 5 years building production systems and I specialize in full-stack development, and AI integration.

items.question: How does your process work?
items.answer: Quick call to understand your problem. Working prototype in days. Iterate with your feedback. Most projects go live in 2-4 weeks.

items.question: Is there a limit to revisions?
items.answer: Nope. I iterate until it works for your team. I'd rather spend extra time getting it right than leave you with something half-baked.

items.question: How fast can you deliver?
items.answer: First working prototype: 48-72 hours. Full project: depends on scope, but typically 2-4 weeks. I'll give you a realistic timeline upfront.

items.question: What if I don't like what you build?
items.answer: I'll keep working on it. Unlimited revisions until you're happy. If I genuinely can't deliver what you need, I'll tell you early, not after you've paid.

items.question: Do you work with Shopify/WordPress/etc?
items.answer: Yes. I integrate with most platforms and can work with whatever stack you're already using. Tell me what you have, I'll figure it out.

items.question: Can I pause or cancel?
items.answer: For ongoing support: yes, any time. For fixed projects: I scope clearly upfront so there are no surprises. Need to pause? Just tell me.

items.question: Why not hire a full-time developer?
items.answer: A good full-time dev costs €40-80k/year plus benefits, and you're locked in. With me, you pay for what you need, when you need it. Scale up for a big push, scale down when things are stable.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: I don't do refunds, but I also don't disappear. If something's not right, I fix it. If you need to pause, I pause. My reputation matters more than a single project.
